snippet.title: Codex Mortis | Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Watch the release date trailer for Codex Mortis. Command the dead and unleash chaos when Codex Mortis releases on March 26, 2026, on Steam.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4084120/CODEX_MORTIS/

Codex Mortis is a necromantic survival bullet hell where death is your greatest weapon. Mix five schools of dark magic, unleash devastating spell synergies, and raise undead armies across eight unique levels - each demanding a different strategy. Plan your build, assemble your squad, and watch carefully crafted chaos unfold solo or in local co-op. The game is developed entirely through AI-driven development by GROLAF.
